decks.notes: The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. This deck aims to control the game using cards like Red Elemental Blast, Pyroblast, and Lightning Bolt, while also having the ability to tutor for combo pieces using cards like Goblin Engineer and Urza's Saga. The deck also has additional win conditions like Breya's Apprentice and Phyrexian Dragon Engine. Overall, the deck focuses on efficiently setting up and executing its combo strategy to win the game.

The deck is centered around the Doomsday combo, which involves stacking your deck in a specific order to win the game in a single turn. The deck uses various cards like Personal Tutor and Thoughtseize to set up the combo efficiently, while also including counter spells like Force of Will and Daze for protection. The inclusion of cards like Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond allow for fast mana acceleration to execute the combo quickly. Utilizing cards like Thassa's Oracle and Doomsday as the win conditions, this deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces rapidly to secure victory.

This UWx Control deck focuses on using a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler, alongside control elements like Force of Will and Counterbalance, to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for a win condition with cards like Monastery Mentor. The deck also includes board control options like Supreme Verdict and Swords to Plowshares, as well as card advantage tools like Snapcaster Mage and Narset, Parter of Veils. Additionally, the deck utilizes fetch lands and cantrip spells to ensure consistency in drawing key cards.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts to control the game through a prison strategy. By utilizing cards like Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, Pithing Needle, and Karn, the Great Creator, the deck aims to disrupt your opponent's plans while generating value through cards like Mox Diamond and Karn, Scion of Urza. The deck also includes powerful lands such as Ancient Tomb, City of Traitors, and Urza's Saga to ramp and further strengthen the artifact prison strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to use artifacts to quickly generate mana and card advantage, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Pithing Needle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch acts as a powerful recursion engine, while Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for crucial artifacts. The deck aims to take control of the game early on and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and disruptive elements.

The main focus of this Grixis Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using efficient and powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan through cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will. The deck also includes a suite of card draw and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistent draws and maximize the chances of drawing into threats. Additionally, the deck has access to removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out to control the board and clear the way for its aggressive creatures to push through for the win.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponents' strategies by utilizing efficient removal spells and counterspells. By utilizing cards like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure, combined with disruptive spells like Wasteland and Force of Will to control the game, the deck aims to establish early dominance and maintain tempo throughout the match. The inclusion of cards like Brainstorm and Ponder allow for card selection and manipulation, ensuring consistency in drawing necessary pieces to maintain aggression and disrupt opponents' game plans.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly put pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow and Delver of Secrets, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze. The deck focuses on controlling the board with counterspells such as Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as removing enemy threats with Snuff Out. The inclusion of Murktide Regent adds another powerful threat to the mix. Wasteland is used to keep the opponent off balance and the deck is rounded out with card draw and fetch lands for consistency.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath to pressure the opponent while disrupting their plays with cards like Force of Will and Daze. It also includes graveyard recursion with Reanimate and value creatures like Baleful Strix. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color identity, while also running disruptive lands like Wasteland. The goal is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy, ultimately overwhelming them with a mix of aggression and control.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Mystic Forge in combination with various artifacts, like Lion's Eye Diamond and Basalt Monolith, to generate infinite mana and card advantage. This allows for explosive plays and combo potential with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Walking Ballista. The deck aims to quickly assemble its pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful combo finish. Using cards like Defense Grid and Mesmeric Orb to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while leveraging the power of Mystic Forge as a central engine of the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly playing disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void, Blood Moon, and Trinisphere to disrupt opponent's game plan. By ramping out with fast mana sources like City of Traitors and Chrome Mox, the deck aims to lock opponents out of casting spells while deploying aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury to close out the game quickly. The use of Magus of the Moon and Ancient Tomb further pressures opponents' mana base, while Den of the Bugbear and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional ways to apply pressure and close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere, while quickly deploying aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury to apply pressure. The deck also utilizes cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to accelerate its game plan and close out games quickly. Overall, the deck focuses on locking down the opponent while maintaining a fast clock through aggressive creatures and burn spells.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to control the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to maintain aggressive pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares. By utilizing a mix of card advantage engines like Brainstorm and Ponder, as well as creature threats and removal spells, this deck aims to tempo out opponents and secure victory through incremental advantage.

The main focus of this Grixis Aggro deck is to maintain a fast and aggressive tempo by controlling the board using efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out while disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize. The deck also heavily relies on card selection through Ponder and Brainstorm to guarantee consistent draws and maximize the efficiency of Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The creature base is built around quick, evasive threats like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters to apply pressure on the opponent. The mana base is optimized for consistency and mana denial with Wasteland and fetch lands.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counter spells, discard spells, and removal while gaining card advantage through card draw and card filtering. The deck utilizes efficient threats like Baleful Strix and Snapcaster Mage to control the board and apply pressure when necessary. Narset, Parter of Veils helps to shut down opposing card draw strategies, while cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor provide powerful card advantage and selection. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through superior resource management and control.

The deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost, aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to control the game. It also includes powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out to deal with opposing threats. Mishra's Bauble helps to keep card advantage, while Murktide Regent provides a threatening late-game threat. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game and apply pressure on the opponent early on to secure a victory.
